description.value: North Delta Recreation Centre is a City of Delta–operated multi-sport facility offering ice hockey, curling, swimming, skating, fitness, and a wide range of court sports under one roof. It serves the North Delta community as a hub for year-round indoor recreation. Touring cyclists passing through the Delta area may find it a practical stop given its breadth of facilities, though cyclist-specific services are unconfirmed.
